tools.name: foxguard_scan
tools.description: Run the installed Foxguard CLI on an absolute file or directory path. Returns finding counts and locations, rule IDs, CWEs, and descriptions. Requires foxguard on PATH. Scan results depend on the installed scanner version and configuration.

path.description: Absolute file or directory path you have permission to scan.

severity.description: Only return findings at or above this severity.
